sections.form: Svensson is running slightly above expected form per the timing adjustment (+0.095 SG), providing a modest tailwind this week. However, his trend direction is sharply negative (-0.78 SG), indicating deteriorating play relative to his season average, which is a significant concern.
sections.course_fit: Fort Worth shows a net positive course fit (+0.093 SG) driven primarily by driving distance suitability (+0.098 SG), offsetting a slight accuracy headwind (-0.004 SG). His season approach play (+0.50 SG) is a strength, though his -0.36 career putting rating remains a long-term liability.
sections.betting_angle: At #393 WR with DK odds of 100000.0, Svensson is priced as a lottery ticket. The modest gap between model predictions (0.5% win, 3.9% top 10) and DataGolf (0.3% win, 5.8% top 10) offers no compelling edge, and his negative form trend undermines even the course fit advantage.
sections.fantasy: Avoid in tournaments; with 3 uses remaining and deteriorating form despite course fit, the negative trend outweighs the modest adjustments and his salary value is unlikely to materialize.
